frequency_question: How often do emerging market central banks enact incremental reserve ratio mandates during periods of localized banking system liquidity surpluses?
membership_rule: Includes official central bank deployments of incremental or marginal reserve ratio requirements on scheduled bank deposits. Excludes standard benchmark interest rate hikes and standard reserve ratio changes applied uniformly across all historical periods without an 'incremental' or marginal tier.

cases.name: People's Bank of China Targeted Reserve Requirement Ratio adjustments
Bank of Israel Monetary absorption framework adjustments

coverage_note: 3 named cases; represents specialized liquidity management tool usages.
known_gaps: Excludes minor adjustments by smaller developing economies lacking comparable transparency.
skeleton: Major emerging market central bank tightening cycles with localized liquidity overhangs
multiplier: 3 documented systemic deployments across major jurisdictions over 30 years within similar liquidity conditions.
validity_reason: Central bank toolkits evolve slowly over multi-year regulatory cycles.
